elements.name: Retain an arithmetic expression in a model-state parameter

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State
the user opens the model-state table and adds length parameter d0 to the table
The MCAD Software has a model-state table containing length parameter d0
the Primary and Capture State d0 values are 1 in
the user enters "1 in + 0.5 in" in the Copy State d0 cell
accepts and reopens the model-state table
the Copy State d0 cell displays the entered arithmetic expression
the parameter tree displays the active member expression
the Primary and Capture State d0 cells still display 1 in
the user closes the table and opens Parameters
d0 has nominal and model values of 1.5 in
